task: 面向普通成年英语读者的忠实文学译介；自然英语，完整翻译；允许调整分行，不强制押韵，不增加情节。

dimensions.name: 关键语义与文化理解
dimensions.description: 人物、否定、时间、虚实及典故关系是否准确；依据原文独立判断，接受合理多解。

dimensions.name: 完整性与内容边界
dimensions.description: 全文是否覆盖，是否遗漏或新增无依据事实与情节；允许自然合并诗行。

dimensions.name: 意象与修辞再现
dimensions.description: 意象间关系、拟人、比喻、对照和声喻是否成立，不要求逐字复刻。

dimensions.name: 情感、语气与推进
dimensions.description: 情绪方向、强度、含蓄程度、视角和推进是否贴合原作。

dimensions.name: 英语语法准确性
dimensions.description: 真实英语语法错误；合法诗歌省略、倒装及片段不机械扣分。

dimensions.name: 英语自然度与可读性
dimensions.description: 搭配、连贯、可理解性及翻译腔；不偏好更长或更华丽的表达。

dimensions.name: 文体、节奏与整体诗性
dimensions.description: 与原作相称的节奏、停顿、复沓和整体文体；不强制押韵或汉语格律。

internal_anchors.4: 充分实现，只有不影响目标的合理取舍
internal_anchors.3: 基本实现，有局部轻微不足
internal_anchors.2: 部分实现，存在明显损失或不自然
internal_anchors.1: 严重不足，多项重要问题失效
internal_anchors.0: 该方面基本缺失或错误

total_formula: D1..D7 are already weighted points with maxima 30,10,15,15,10,10,10. total = D1+D2+D3+D4+D5+D6+D7, maximum 100; each has at most one decimal place. 0-4 anchors describe relative attainment only. Local code validates ranges and exact sum.

output.score_field: JSON total; local score alias equals total
output.component_scale: weighted points; per-dimension maximum equals weight

judging.temperature_note: Non-thinking numeric score task; zero temperature does not guarantee deterministic scoring.

aggregation.score_run_sd: generation and judge variation are mixed; cannot estimate judge repeat reliability
aggregation.generator_models: report per-track method minus own baseline; same 16 poems are not 32 independent poems

method_note: Only source and anonymous translation are sent with the identical system rubric. No poem-specific gold or coverage units. D1-D7 are subjective weighted rubric scores, not measured grammar accuracy, semantic coverage or critical error rates. Total arithmetic is checked locally.
